# reminder target

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:reminderTarget`](gmeow-reminderTarget.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/reminderTarget>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The event this reminder is attached to.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Reminder`](../classes/gmeow-Reminder.md) -> [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:reminderTarget`](gmeow-reminderTarget.md) from [`gmeow:Reminder`](../classes/gmeow-Reminder.md) to [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Reminder`](../classes/gmeow-Reminder.md), [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a reminder to the one [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) it alerts about — the target whose start an offset trigger is measured from.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one (it is functional — one target per reminder) and avoid pointing it at a schedule; a reminder fires for a concrete occurrence.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) target; an [xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) [`gmeow:reminderTrigger`](gmeow-reminderTrigger.md) is then resolved relative to that event's start.

### Examples

- ex:standupAlarm [`gmeow:reminderTarget`](gmeow-reminderTarget.md) ex:standupEvent.
